dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL (OpenCOBOL) with SCREEN SECTION, FOREGROUND-COLOR/BACKGROUND-COLOR, ACCEPT FROM ESCAPE KEY, AT line/column addressing — typical of GnuCOBOL interactive terminal programs. Brazilian Portuguese comments and date notation (29 SET 2011). COBOL-LE mentioned in remarks likely refers to IBM COBOL/LE naming convention used loosely.
evidence: ACCEPT WS-OPCAO AT 2580 WITH AUTO UPDATE

purpose.domain_detail: Activity management system — menu-driven caller program for subprograms handling activity inclusion/alteration, exclusion, write-off, and monthly/annual movement generation. Likely an academic or small business exercise in Brazilian Portuguese.
purpose.summary: ATV00 is a main menu program that displays a text-based screen menu with four options related to activity management (inclusion/alteration, exclusion, write-off, and monthly/annual movement generation). It accepts keyboard navigation (arrow keys, F12, ESC) and calls one of four subprograms (ATV01–ATV04) based on the selected option.

notable_features: SCREEN SECTION with box-drawing characters (IBM CP850/latin-1)
ACCEPT FROM ESCAPE KEY for function key detection
88-level condition names for key codes (CN-ESC, CN-PF12, CN-BAIXO, CN-CIMA)
AT line/column addressing in DISPLAY statements
verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1; box-drawing characters in SCREEN SECTION are IBM CP850 extended ASCII, consistent with GnuCOBOL on Windows or Linux with a DOS-style terminal. The REMARKS mention 'COBOL-LE' which is an IBM term, but the SCREEN SECTION syntax is characteristic of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL. Source was truncated before the RTCHAMASUB CALL statements were fully visible. Author is Brazilian (Portuguese comments, SET for September).
